Bash(git commit -m "Add TUI dashboard implementation using gocui

- Created cmd/dashboard with main.go and config files
- Implemented internal/dashboard package with core TUI logic:
  - app.go: Application structure, config loading, polling loop
  - layout.go: UI layout with header, main view, and status bar
  - render.go: Agent list rendering with color-coded statuses
  - keymap.go: Keybindings for navigation and actions
  - actions.go: Continue session, window management, logs view
  
Features:
- Auto-refresh every 5 seconds (configurable)
- Color-coded agent statuses (active, working, idle, failed)
- Vim-style keybindings (j/k for navigation)
- Continue session with ''c'' key (runs claude -c)
- Bring window to front with ''w'' key (AppleScript)
- Show logs with ''L'' key
- Toggle all/active agents with ''a'' key
- Manual refresh with ''r'' key
- Quit with ''q'' key

Builds successfully as: bin/dashboard")
